UC-752.en: Clauseo is a small open-source project with no funding yet, so this beta isn't signed by Apple or Microsoft. Your computer asks before it opens Clauseo the first time.

UC-753.en: Mac: drag Clauseo onto Applications and open it. macOS says it can't be opened: click Done or OK, not the button that moves it to the Bin. Then open System Settings, click Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and click Open Anyway. On macOS 15 and later, right-clicking the app and choosing Open no longer gets past this block. Installing Clauseo on a Mac shows each click.

UC-754.en: If macOS says Clauseo "is damaged": this one line in Terminal removes the "downloaded from the internet" mark from Clauseo alone: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Clauseo.app. Then open Clauseo again. On a work Mac, ask your IT team before you do this.

UC-755.en: Windows: a blue box says Windows protected your PC. Click More info, then Run anyway. Installing Clauseo on Windows shows each click.
